title: La ville et ses bannières
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished, high-fidelity portrait native iPhone app UI concept for O Mas La, a French Guadeloupe carnival group locator. Full-bleed flat screen image, tall 9:19.5 aspect ratio. No outer device frame, no hands, no montage, no presentation title, no perspective on the UI. This is a VISUAL EXPLORATION, not an implemented screenshot.
Reference image is ONLY the approved composition and exact functional hierarchy. Keep the map as the top ~63% and ONE unified bottom sheet occupying the bottom ~37%, search inside that sheet, selected group details and CTA beneath it. Keep native iOS safe areas/status bar, small O Mas La wordmark upper left and account circular button upper right. Precise system sans type and professional optical spacing. Change the MAP ART DIRECTION AND GROUP REPRESENTATION decisively according to the direction below. Do not copy generic Apple/Google map colors or blue UI style.
Map depicts a convincing but ILLUSTRATIVE coastal street network around Pointe-à-Pitre, sea at west/lower-left, dense city blocks inland, land-based markers anchored to exact small dots in streets. Show readable restrained location labels "Pointe-à-Pitre", "La Darse", "Place de la Victoire". The coastline is illustrative, not a navigation artifact. No route lines, predicted path, direction arrows, footprints, crowd footprint, heatmaps, member count, distance, travel time or speed. At most three groups. Selected "Tambour bleu"; secondary "Brise" and "Soleil orange". Groups have DIFFERENT identity colors, which do not encode live/recent status. The only status code is a small separate green dot plus explicit text.
Lower sheet in order: thin drag handle; search "Chercher un groupe"; heading "Tambour bleu" with close control; green dot "En direct" and small "Référent GPS · il y a 20 s"; large full-width action "Rejoindre ce point"; small legible caption "Vers la dernière position connue.". One unified surface with no nestedcards. Small label immediately above sheet exact "Concept · groupes fictifs". Keep map labels quiet, selected group primary. Symbols consistently drawn, not emoji. No carnival feather/party-confetti decoration unless explicitly specified below. Render all text accurately with French accents.
DIRECTION 2 — LA VILLE ET SES BANNIERES. Transform the map into a beautifully restrained live three-dimensional city model seen at a shallow 25-degree camera pitch. Only map geometry has perspective; all interface controls and text remain flat. Coastal Pointe-à-Pitre is rendered with real-map-like street connectivity, warm oyster buildings extruded a few pixels, pale terracotta rooftops, ivory roads, deep teal water #0A6568. Short soft realistic building shadows. Almost architectural model quality, tactile but light, not a toy game or fantasy city. Streets and place names remain plainly legible in screen space. No invented signature landmarks, no crowds or 3D people. UI warm ivory and deep-teal ink. CTA deep teal.
GROUPS: each location is a SMALL VERTICAL RALLY BANNER standing at a pinpoint GPS anchor. A short fine pole attached exactly to a street point, an upright rectangular cloth-like standard with a subtle natural fold, a simple fictional flat crest inside. Selected Tambour bleu is cobalt banner with ivory abstract drum emblem, secondary Brise is emerald banner/wave, Soleil orange burnt-orange banner/sun. Clearly separated compact labels sit adjacent to each banner. The flags symbolize group identity only, not heading, wind, footprint or crowd size. At most three small banners, no grand carnival scenery. The selected banner and its lower sheet share a small matching crest. This direction should feel immediately recognizable as finding a procession in a city, while remaining a precise mobile map.
purpose: Exploration du fond de carte et des repères ; composition A conservée ; aucun code runtime modifié.
limits: Géographie et positions illustratives, aucun trajet exploitable.
La 3D détaillée de la variante 02 est une intention artistique, pas une preuve de rendu du moteur.
userDecision: je préfère la ville en relief + bannière mais je ne pense pas qu'on ait les relief de ville en guadeloupe, par contre les bannières j'aime beaucoup l'idée !
